current_law_hits.snippet: Executive Order No. 13927 | Ex. Ord. No. 13927, June 4, 2020, 85 F.R. 35165, which related to accelerating the nation’s economic recovery from the COVID–19 emergency by expediting infrastructure investments and other activities, was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 13990, § 7(a), Jan. 20, 2021, 86 F.R. 7041, set out in a note under section 4321 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare.
